title: Downloads and usage rights

body.text: You can download as an audio (and video) file. Commercial usage rights
— the free plan is usually personal use only. If you'll use it in ads or to earn money, always check your plan's terms first.

example: Before using a song in a monetized YouTube clip → check whether your plan allows commercial use

title: Don't imitate real artists

body.text: Avoid naming a real artist to 'copy their voice' — it violates the terms and risks copyright issues. Instead, describe the
, e.g. 'a warm, deep male voice, indie style' — safer and still effective.

example: Instead of 'sing like artist X' use 'a clear, bright female voice, K-pop style, upbeat'
